framing_issues.issue: Vague when read alone: it doesn't say which requests (to speak in person, or Zoom comments) or where to send them (the sources don't say; the explainer suggests calling 404-612-8200). It also leaves out that speaking isn't guaranteed: Fulton residents go first, and comment time is capped at 60 minutes (P-036).

framing_issues.text: The Budget Commission, two commissioners and two county staff
framing_issues.issue: "Two county staff" is vague on its own; name them (the county manager and the chief financial officer, P-008).
Read alone, "file" can mean "submit". The next sentence explains it, but the line also leaves out that the vote was 4 to 1 and that a motion to approve had failed on Oct 21 (P-024, P-034).
